regimens.dose_text: 80 mg orally once daily (or 40 mg once daily in patients intolerant to 80 mg) for high-intensity lipid-lowering and plaque stabilization following ischemic stroke or TIA. Administer at any time of day, with or without food.

mg_safety.note: Statins can rarely worsen myasthenia gravis weakness or induce necrotizing autoimmune myopathy (anti-HMGCR antibodies); use with caution and monitor symptoms

mechanism_of_action.value: LIPITOR is a selective, competitive inhibitor of HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme that converts 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A to mevalonate, a precursor of sterols, including cholesterol. In animal models, LIPITOR lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase and cholesterol synthesis in the liver.
